name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Soviet chemist and graduate student of Aleskovskii who co-developed the molecular layering method.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: National academy of sciences of the Soviet Union.

name: Molecular Layering
